PROP-current-fina-inv-024.text: Liquidity mining rewards must be updated atomically with deposit operations.
PROP-current-fina-inv-024.assertion: forall deposit(obligation): miner.update_reward(obligation) called within same tx as deposit

locations.note: Calls handle_mint then immediately calls miner.update_obligation_reward_manager in same function body
Internal mint that mints ctokens and deposits to obligation; reward update happens after return in entry point
